For supersingular rank‑2 Drinfeld \(\mathbb{F}_q[T]\)-modules the space of morphisms of \(\tau\)-degree at most \(s\) reaches its maximal \(\mathbb{F}_q\)-dimension already when \(s\) hits \(d-2\).  Hence, for every \(s\ge d-2\) the dimension is constant and equals \(d-1\):

\[
\boxed{\,m_s \;=\; d-1\qquad\text{for all }s\ge d-2\,}.
\]

ANSWER: \(m_s = d-1\) for \(s\ge d-2\).
